name: SEO Scout
description_en:
SEO Scout combines Search Console performance analysis with content research, internal-link analysis and documented SEO change testing. Its unlimited-keyword language concerns queries available through the connected Search Console workflow, while sites, Google accounts, research reports and crawl allowances remain separately limited. It is useful to evaluate the measurement and content workflow before considering live website changes.

The public materials contain operational steps, but also old release markers and inconsistent test-indexing assumptions. This profile therefore distinguishes documented workflows from current account availability. An editor score, a detected query overlap or a before/after uplift is evidence for investigation, not proof of content quality, harmful cannibalization or causation.
description_zh:
SEO Scout 将 Search Console 表现分析与内容研究、内链分析及文档化 SEO 改动测试组合。其无限关键词说法针对已连接 Search Console 工作流可取的查询，网站、Google 账户、研究报告及抓取额度仍分别受限。评估时可先看测量和内容流程，再考虑真实网站改动。

公开资料有操作步骤，也保留旧版本标记及不一致的测试索引假设。因此本档区分文档工作流与当前账户供应。编辑器分数、查询重叠或前后流量增长可用于调查，不证明内容质量、有害关键词竞争或因果。

core_features.explanation_en: Review suggested source pages that do not already link to a target.

en: Explore connected query groups and investigate page overlap.
Review content and internal-link opportunities with a human editor.
Evaluate a narrow SEO change test with explicit dates and recovery requirements.
zh: 分析连接的查询分组并调查页面重叠。
由编辑审内容与内链机会。
在明确日期及恢复要求下评估少量 SEO 改动测试。
use_cases.basis: Editorial workflow examples; not observed customer outcomes.

faq.question_en: Does a page overlap automatically need consolidation?
faq.answer_en: No. Inspect per-page intent and query metrics before deciding whether the overlap is harmful.
faq.answer_zh: 不一定。先审逐页意图及查询指标，判断是否有害。

faq.question_en: Does a high content grade guarantee ranking?
faq.answer_en: No. It is a vendor comparison with selected results, not verified search-engine acceptance.
faq.answer_zh: 不保证。它是厂商相对所选结果的比较，不是已验证的搜索引擎接纳。

official_check.scope: Official public documentation only; no purchase, account operation, sending test, identity or publication approval.

review_notes: Original English and corresponding Chinese research draft. Vendor statements describe documented behavior, not independently measured quality.
Existing third-party source is discovery-only and superseded. Unknown UI languages, regional availability and licensing remain unknown.
All publication and alternative-relationship states remain unapproved.

sections.title_en: Unlimited keywords do not mean unlimited independent rank checks
sections.title_zh: 无限关键词不等于无限独立排名探测
sections.en: The rank-tracking page explicitly connects the workflow to Google Search Console and offers query groups, new/lost terms and historical comparison. The scope is what the connected property reports, not every possible keyword on the internet. Editorial evaluation: confirm the selected property, period and filters before interpreting average positions or missing terms. The exact import latency, completeness, anonymized-query treatment and backfill range were not established. Do not equate this account-derived view with a fixed daily probe from a particular location and device.
sections.zh: 排名页明确连接 Google Search Console，提供查询分组、新增／流失词及历史比较。范围是连接属性报告的内容，不是互联网所有可能关键词。编辑评估：解释平均位置或缺词前核属性、期间及筛选。准确导入延迟、完整度、匿名查询处理及回填范围未确定。不能将此账户来源视图等同于指定地区／设备的每日固定探测。

sections.title_en: A new keyword depends on the selected metric
sections.title_zh: 新增关键词取决于所选指标
sections.en: The performance report can sort queries by clicks, impressions, CTR or position, and filter by a phrase to redraw grouped trends. Its New/Lost example distinguishes a query newly sending clicks from one newly recording impressions. Weekly email updates are described separately. Editorial analysis: retain the metric and comparison periods; zero clicks does not mean zero impressions or no ranking. A group total can change because its query mix changes. Complete exports, email-recipient controls and delivery success were not verified.
sections.zh: 表现报告可按点击、展示、CTR、位置排序，并按短语重绘分组趋势。New／Lost 示例区分新产生点击与新记录展示，另描述每周邮件更新。编辑分析：保指标及比较期间；零点击不等于零展示或无排名，分组总量也可因查询构成改变。完整导出、邮件收件控制及送达未核。

sections.title_en: Saving a test is documented as a live-site action
sections.title_zh: 保存测试属于文档所述真实改站动作
sections.en: The FAQ starts with an installed integration, Low CTR Pages and page analysis, then Create Test, revised title/description and Save & Start Test. It says the change goes live. Editorial acceptance: preserve the original output, choose a narrow authorized URL and inspect what visitors receive. The FAQ distinguishes WordPress server HTML from later JavaScript changes, so verify source HTML and rendered output separately. Current plugin compatibility and reliable stop/rollback procedures were not established; do not begin a production test without confirming recovery in the actual account. Nothing was installed or changed here.
sections.zh: FAQ 从已安装集成、Low CTR Pages 和页面分析开始，再 Create Test、填新标题／描述、Save & Start Test，并称改动上线。编辑验收：保原输出，选少量获授权 URL，核访客实际收到什么。FAQ 区分 WordPress 服务端 HTML 与后续 JavaScript 修改，应分核源码和渲染。当前插件兼容及可靠停止／回退未确定，真实账户恢复方式未确认前不要开始生产测试。本研究未安装或改站。

sections.title_en: Before/after comparison is not automatically a randomized experiment
sections.title_zh: 前后比较不自动构成随机实验
sections.en: The testing page distinguishes single-page before/after tests from multi-page tests with control pages. It aligns weekdays in comparison periods and describes query-level gains/losses. The FAQ assumes three days before indexing while the feature page says two; neither is a measured guarantee that Google indexed a particular change. The feature page also leaves automated change tracking marked as launching imminently. Editorial design: document the actual change date, observed search appearance, cohort and competing events. A coincident improvement can reflect seasonality, query mix or other work; the public procedure does not establish statistical causation.
sections.zh: 测试页区分单页前后比较与有控制页的多页测试，按同星期日对齐期间，并查逐查询得失。FAQ 假设三天索引等待，功能页写两天；两者都不是 Google 已收录具体改动的实测保证。功能页仍将自动改动跟踪标为即将上线。编辑设计：记真实改动日、观察到的搜索呈现、分组及同期事件。同期改善可能来自季节、查询构成或其他工作，公开流程不能确定统计因果。

sections.title_en: Multiple URLs are a diagnosis prompt, not an automatic merge decision
sections.title_zh: 多 URL 是诊断线索，不是自动合并决定
sections.en: The cannibalization workflow filters queries with more than one ranking URL and opens impressions, clicks and positions for each page. Its own explanation acknowledges that multiple URLs are not always a problem. Editorial decision: inspect intent, the preferred landing page and whether pages alternate or serve different users. Internal linking, page revision and consolidation are possible interventions, not automatic prescriptions. Preserve useful support content and redirect plans before merging anything; a duplicate-query flag alone does not justify deletion or demonstrate lost conversions.
sections.zh: 关键词竞争流程筛多排名 URL 查询，再逐页看展示、点击和位置；官方自身也承认多 URL 不一定有问题。编辑判断：审意图、预期落地页，以及是否交替排名或服务不同人群。内链、修订和整合是可选干预，不是自动处方。合并前保有用支持内容及重定向计划；重复查询标记本身不支持删除，也不证明损失转化。

sections.title_en: Find candidate source pages before editing links
sections.title_zh: 先找候选来源页，再改链接
sections.en: The internal-link guide opens a target URL from Internal Link Analysis and selects Internal Links. It uses the target’s top keywords to suggest relevant pages that do not already link to it; the editor then changes those source pages. Editorial review: read the actual passage, confirm destination/anchor usefulness and avoid adding irrelevant links just to raise a count. Recommendations depend on crawled content and query evidence, so a missing suggestion is not proof that no useful source exists. Check the resulting link on the live page.
sections.zh: 内链指南在 Internal Link Analysis 打开目标 URL，再选 Internal Links，以目标热门查询建议尚未链接它的相关页面，随后由编辑改来源页。编辑审核：读真实段落，核目标／锚文用途，不为增数加无关链接。建议依赖已抓内容及查询证据，未见建议不证明没有有用来源。修改后核真实页面链接。

sections.title_en: Read contextual links and navigation counts separately
sections.title_zh: 分别读正文链接与导航计数
sections.en: The Sites/Internal Links guide lists incoming links, in-content incoming links, unique anchors and outgoing internal/external links alongside Search Console metrics. It suggests an advanced filter such as incoming internal links below10. This is a triage threshold, not an externally validated quality boundary. Editorial review: distinguish a sitewide menu link from a contextual reference and inspect coverage before calling a page orphaned. Crawl omissions can leave links unseen. The feature page also groups opportunities by relevance, but does not establish an automatic native-CMS publishing transaction.
sections.zh: Sites／Internal Links 指南把入链、正文入链、独特锚文、内外出链与 Search Console 指标并列，可按入链少于10等高级筛选排查。这是排查阈值，不是外部验证的质量界线。编辑审核：区分全站菜单与正文引用，确认覆盖后再称孤页；漏抓会漏见链接。功能页也按相关性给机会，但未确定自动原生 CMS 发布事务。

sections.title_en: Research clusters and observed-query groups have different inputs
sections.title_zh: 研究主题簇与已观察查询分组输入不同
sections.en: The Keyword Groups research page combines gathered questions and suggestions into themes, with potential search volume and a handoff to the content planner. This is different from grouping existing Search Console phrases in the performance view. Editorial planning: retain which workflow supplied the group and inspect whether its terms share a user need before assigning one article. A summed potential volume is not guaranteed incremental traffic, and a suggested cluster does not remove overlap with existing pages.
sections.zh: Keyword Groups 研究页将收集的问题／建议归主题，给潜在搜索量并可交内容规划器；它不同于表现视图中对已有 Search Console 短语分组。编辑规划：保来源工作流，判断词是否共享用户需求，再分配文章。潜在量求和不保证增量流量，建议主题簇也不消除与既有页面重叠。

sections.title_en: The content grade compares selected SERP material
sections.title_zh: 内容分数比较所选 SERP 资料
sections.en: The grader guide starts with New topic search, then Keyword groups, Questions & Answers and supporting terms before Content editor. It describes comprehensiveness relative to the top30results using word count, reading grade and term frequency. The editor feature page also describes topic/entity analysis. Editorial use: verify the search intent and source set, then make a useful original draft. The score is the vendor’s comparison model, not Google’s quality score or factual review. Current backend/model version, exact weights and the relevance of the source results were not independently verified.
sections.zh: 评分指南从 New topic search 开始，先看 Keyword groups、Questions & Answers 及辅助词，再进 Content editor。其完整性相对前30结果，参考字数、阅读级别、词频；编辑器页另描述主题／实体分析。编辑使用：核意图和来源集合，再写有用原创稿。此分数是厂商比较模型，不是 Google 质量分或事实审稿。当前后端／模型版本、准确权重及来源结果相关性未独立核实。

sections.title_en: Data download and deletion are support-mediated rights in the public terms
sections.title_zh: 公开条款的数据下载及删除通过支持申请
sections.en: The terms say Search Console data belongs to the customer and can be requested for deletion, and invite download/full-deletion requests through support. They state restrictions on commercial reuse and third-party disclosure while reserving aggregate successful-test marketing. These are vendor commitments, not an independent privacy or security audit. Editorial exit: request required exports before cancelling and confirm scope, format and completion. The public text did not establish a self-service cancellation procedure, response time, complete history retention or what happens to injected tests after access ends.
sections.zh: 条款称 Search Console 数据属客户，可申请删除；下载／全删除通过支持申请。它限制商业复用及第三方披露，同时保留汇总成功测试用于营销的权利。这是厂商承诺，不是独立隐私／安全审计。编辑退出：取消前申请所需导出，核范围、格式及完成。公开文未确定自助取消、响应时间、完整历史保留或到期后注入测试如何处理。

sections.title_en: Old release markers limit present-day certainty
sections.title_zh: 旧发布标记限制当前确定性
sections.en: The pricing table still labels Site Audits as coming soon in late2020, although the homepage and guides describe crawl/link features as available. The testing page similarly retains an imminent-release statement. Editorial evaluation: treat these contradictions as documentation freshness gaps, obtain account-specific confirmation and demonstrate the required workflow before buying for that feature. A current copyright year does not prove that every feature paragraph or limit was updated. This research establishes what the public documents say, not current logged-in availability.
sections.zh: 价格表仍把 Site Audits 标为2020年底即将上线，首页及指南却当作已有抓取／链接功能；测试页也保即将发布字样。编辑评估：将冲突列文档时效缺口，按账户确认并演示所需流程后再为该功能采购。当前版权年不能证明每段功能／额度已更新。本研究确定公开文档所述，不确定登录后的当前供应。

seo.title_zh: SEO Scout：Search Console 分析、内容分数及 SEO 测试

seo.description_zh: 评估 SEO Scout 查询报告、页面重叠、内链、内容分数及文档所述真实测试限制。
seo.primary_intent: Evaluate SEO Scout documented analysis and change-testing workflows
secondary_questions: What does unlimited keyword tracking measure?
Is a single-page test a true A/B experiment?

research_gaps.en: No Google authorization, plugin installation, test, payment, report delivery or data request was executed.
research_gaps.zh: 未执行 Google 授权、插件安装、测试、支付、报告投递或数据申请。

research_gaps.en: Current logged-in audit/testing availability, billing-state amounts, cancellation and rollback behavior remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 当前登录后审计／测试供应、账单状态金额、取消及回退行为未核。

research_gaps.en: Import completeness/latency, full export/retention, team permissions, model weights, UI languages and source license remain unknown.
research_gaps.zh: 导入完整度／延迟、全导出／保留、团队权限、模型权重、界面语言及源码许可仍未知。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation. Examples and fit judgments are editorial, not executed tests.
